package.description: A terminal multiplexer whose panes keep running after you detach and can pass messages to each other, with tmux's keys and commands.

en-US.description: A terminal multiplexer whose panes keep running after you detach and can pass messages to each other, with tmux's keys and commands.
en-US.longDescription:
keepane is a terminal multiplexer whose panes keep running after you
detach and can pass messages to each other. A named pane gets messages in
an inbox and takes each one when it is ready: a shell runs it at its next
prompt, a program reads it when it asks. Every message carries its sender
and its task, and an event log and a dashboard show what became of it.
Scripts, people and AI agents (through a built-in MCP server) send the
same messages. tmux's keys, commands and tmux.conf syntax, and sessions
that survive a reboot.
en-US.name: keepane
